data.name: Gwendalyn
data.gender_notes: Gwendalyn is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Gwendalyn is derived from the Welsh words gwend meaning 'white, fair, blessed' and lyn meaning 'wave'. It is a beautiful name that conveys a sense of purity and grace. The name Gwendalyn carries the meaning “White wave, fair one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Gwendalyn usually hope their child will grow to embody white wave, fair one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Gwendalyn is a name with deep spiritual significance. It is believed to be the name of a powerful fairy queen in Welsh mythology, and it is also the name of several saints in the Christian tradition. Gwendalyn represents the divine feminine and the power of the natural world.
data.etymology: Gwendalyn belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “White wave, fair one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gwendalyn total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
